stem: Why does Princess become upset with Roddy?

options.label: F
options.text: She is jealous of Roddy's friendship with Jacob.

options.label: G
options.text: She thinks Roddy's idea to fix the doghouse is foolish.

options.label: H
options.text: She is offended that Roddy thought she would be a dog.

options.label: J
options.text: She is bothered that Roddy does not offer his room to her.
